About Render is a cloud platform for builders that helps teams deploy and run applications, APIs, background jobs, databases, cron jobs, and workflows with minimal operational overhead. It provides managed infrastructure primitives for modern software delivery, including web services, static sites, private services, Postgres databases, key-value storage, autoscaling, preview environments, zero-downtime deploys, and integrated observability. Managed hosting for web services, static sites, and private services Fully managed Postgres and Redis-compatible key-value storage Autoscaling, preview environments, and zero-downtime deploys Infrastructure as code, Docker support, and REST API access Integrated logs, metrics, and monitoring for deployed services Free Tier Value 48 FTV score Est. value $8.00 / month Credit card Not stated Feature parity 78% This free tier is genuinely usable, but it is capped: 25 services, 5 GB of bandwidth, 500 build minutes, 5 retained builds, and only 1 workspace/seat. The cheapest paid workspace plan is Pro at $25/month, and the free offering covers a meaningful slice of that experience, so it’s worth about $8/month; a credit card is required to sign up, which adds some friction.
